_comment: Live config for Duckdoku Blast. Copy this file into the jvea03/duckdoku-privacy repo as config.json; it is then served at https://jvea03.github.io/duckdoku-privacy/config.json, which is RemoteConfig.CONFIG_URL. Every value below is the shipped default, so publishing it as-is changes nothing: edit a number, commit, and players pick it up at their next launch (and after an hour away). Only keys in Tunables.DEFAULTS are accepted, with the right type and within 0 to 20x the default; anything else is ignored and a broken file changes nothing.

inbox.title: Leaderboards are live!
inbox.body: Win levels to earn anchors and climb the daily, weekly and season boards. The top 3 win coin prizes! Here are 200 coins to get you started.

inbox.title: Sorry about the leaderboards!
inbox.body: Thanks for playing in our first leaderboard week! Some players ended up on a different daily board because of their time zone, so they couldn't see each other. This update fixes that: everyone now shares the same boards, and they all reset at the same moment worldwide. Here's a little something for your patience.

inbox.title: Thanks for joining the launch!
inbox.body: Thank you for playing Duckdoku Blast in its very first weeks! This update is packed with improvements: volume sliders, profile stats, new sounds, smoother screens and more. The Thanksgiving Pass is a one-time mini pass: 20 tiers in just two weeks, with the Cornucopia Ship and a Thanksgiving sticker. Here are 10 golden ducks, enough to unlock its Premium track for free!

inbox.title: Happy Thanksgiving! 2× anchors all weekend
inbox.body: From Thursday to Sunday, every win pays 2× anchors: climb your Thanksgiving Pass and the leaderboards twice as fast! Join the World Duck Hunt too: find ducks with players everywhere to unlock the Turkey Duck! The Thanksgiving Feast is on through Cyber Monday: 130,000 coins and 10 of every booster for $4.99. Here's a free Bomb to start your weekend!
